title: The Shocking Truth Behind Dettol | 100 Years of Trust | Success Story | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "The Shocking Truth Behind Dettol | 100 Years of Trust | Success Story | No.1 Hygiene Brand | Live Hindi"

Have you ever wondered how a small bottle of antiseptic liquid became a trusted essential in every Indian household, school, hospital, and clinic? In this video, we reveal the incredible success story of Dettol — a journey that started in 1840 in a small flour mill in England and went on to become one of the world’s most iconic hygiene brands.

Discover how Dettol played a crucial role during World War II, saving thousands of lives in maternity wards and battlefield hospitals. Learn how this liquid antiseptic transformed into a global symbol of protection, dominating India’s antiseptic liquid market with over 85% share and leading the soap, handwash, and surface disinfectant categories across multiple countries.

We also dive deep into the emotional branding behind Dettol’s famous tagline “Dettol ka Dhula,” how it overtook Lifebuoy to become India’s No.1 soap brand during the COVID-19 pandemic, and the legal battles that followed. From its merger with Benckiser to the impact of campaigns like “Dettol Salutes” and its role in Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, this video uncovers how Dettol became more than just a product — it became a daily habit and a trusted part of millions of lives.

If you're interested in brand journeys, business case studies, and how powerful marketing can shape consumer behavior — this is a story you shouldn't miss.
